FAIR.description: Strong vanilla strategy under explicit house rules. Win decisively through normal player interface without game-mechanic exploits.
allowed: Retreating to defense river and mountain lines
Air superiority, CAS support, and logistics strikes
Naval blockades, convoy raiding, and amphibious invasions
Efficient industrial construction and ahead-of-time technology planning
Designer and Military Industrial Organization (MIO) optimization
Lawful focus branch and diplomatic expansion

banned_exploits.bugs_and_caps: No equipment duplication, free research loops, special forces cap bypass, or template-conversion stat laundering.
banned_exploits.division_armor: No line tank/SPG/TD mixed with leg infantry/cavalry solely to transfer armor stat (space marine ban). Keep foot defenders and mobile assault separate.
banned_exploits.diplomacy: No military-access order-66 betrayal, fake wars to manipulate world tension, faction hopping, or artificial civil war triggering.
banned_exploits.economy: No unneeded resource trading for factory gifting, lend-lease market duplication loops, or puppet release spam.
banned_exploits.combat_farming: No endless war farming, attack-cancel farming, or zero-cost template conversions to farm XP.
banned_exploits.defeat_avoidance: No deleting or converting encircled units to rescue equipment via UI loopholes. Relieve or accept the loss.
banned_exploits.ai_manipulation: No repeated empty-port invasion cycling to break AI front assignment.

META.description: Lifts FAIR house bans for single-player campaign challenges. Permits powerful normal-UI mechanics. Never permits console cheats, file hacking, or memory injection.
principles: Strong intended mechanics: snowballing focus paths, optimized width, concentrated firepower
Normal UI mechanics: armor-supported infantry, paratrooper port seizures, subject manpower extraction
Strict boundary: no console/debug commands, no save editing, no memory writes

non_negotiable_boundary: Normal difficulty, vanilla rules, historical AI by default
No console commands (debug/eval/fire_event) in campaign play
No save editing, no memory write injection, no hidden enemy information
Attached window validation and emergency stop killswitch strictly respected
